phase_name: Fixtures pinning the behavior and the non-interference property

objectives.description: Re-read test-orchestrate-cycle-plan.sh immediately before editing; add Group 36 following the file's established idiom

Eight fixture cases across the seven required categories (fires-originating-shape, does-not-fire-within-budget, does-not-fire-no-plan, does-not-fire-zero/absent-headings x2 (zero and non-conforming), mode-aware-disagreement, real-history-counter-case, non-blocking/byte-identical)
objectives.note: Mapped to 12 common_test_pass call sites across 7 Cases (1-7): Case 1 (fires, 2 assertions: presence + component fields), Case 2 (no-fire within budget, 1), Case 3 (no-fire no-plan, 2: absence + still dispatches), Case 4a (no-fire zero headings, 1), Case 4b (no-fire non-conforming heading, 2: absence + still dispatches/not blocked), Case 5 (mode-aware disagreement, 1), Case 6 (phase-10-of-11 real-history counter-case, 1), Case 7 (non-interference/byte-identical, 2: non-vacuous pair + byte-identical diff). Every task-description VERIFICATION bullet maps to at least one passing case; none ended with zero cases.

objectives.description: All assertions use common_test_pass/common_test_fail with $LAST_STDOUT quoted in failure messages, matching the file's convention

approaches_tried.approach: Use --dry-run throughout, including for the byte-identical non-interference fixture (Case 7), seeding cycle_counts via the on-disk .orchestrator-multi-state-<session>.json file
approaches_tried.reason: --dry-run always starts the in-memory multi-task state fresh at {} regardless of any on-disk seeded file (orchestrate-cycle-plan.sh only loads from disk when dry_run != true) -- confirmed by direct code reading and consistent with the pre-existing Group 8 budget fixtures, which deliberately avoid --dry-run for exactly this reason. Case 7 was redesigned to run LIVE twice (fresh task directory + durable loop-guard reset between runs) with distinct pre-seeded cycle_counts (0 vs. 1) on the SAME plan/task/mode, which is the only way to vary remaining_cycles as a genuine single-variable change for a single-task (ntasks=1) batch.
